description: List every markdown and diagram document under a folder of the served folder, with the kind a FOLIO.md declaration gives it. Use it to see what exists or which documents are of a kind; for documents matching a condition - a title, a field's value, a link - query folio.documents or kind.<name> with folio_query, and for one document's blocks use folio_document. Answers {ready, documents: [{path, kind}]}: kind is null where no declaration places the document; ready false means Folio is still reading the folder and the list is incomplete, so ask again shortly. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

folder.description: A folder, relative to the served folder or absolute under it, such as notes/; omit for the whole folder

name: folio_documents
title: List the folder's documents
